It also works with uClibc-0.9.16, but the configuration changed:
- In Rules.mak update CROSS= mipsel-linux-
- 'make menuconfig': change the kernel source dir here. The rest I left unchanged.
- make
- make PREFIX=~/be300/linux/mipsel-uclibc-dev install
- make PREFIX=~/be300/linux/rootfs install_target
